items.q: How big was Stack Overflow at its peak?
items.a: About **207,000 new questions a month** in March 2014.

items.q: How many new questions did it get in September 2026?
What happened to its ownership and data?
items.a: Sold for **$1.8B** to private equity in 2021, then **licensed Q&A data** to Google and OpenAI in 2024.
A high score in a niche tag was **a lever to get a job** and network.

items.q: Why did few people ask questions?
items.a: The **bar was high**—duplicate checks made asking scary.

items.q: What did Prime's favourite Vim answer teach?
items.a: Learn the **composable building blocks** instead of memorising **thousands of leaf shortcuts**.

items.q: How do you apply it to new topics?
items.a: Ask the question **one level deeper** to find the primitives.
